user.title: Connect to the Siemens OZW672
user.description: Enter the connection details of the OZW672 web server.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the OZW672
reauth_confirm.description: The OZW672 rejected the stored credentials. Update them below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the OZW672.

settings.title: Polling settings
settings.description: How often the OZW672 datapoints are read.

builtin_datapoints.title: Built-in datapoints
builtin_datapoints.description: Select the datapoints that exist on your installation and that you want to poll. The built-in catalog matches the reference installation only: deselect the datapoints your plant does not have (they would otherwise fail to read), and declare your own identifiers with 'Add a custom datapoint'.

add_datapoint.title: Add a custom datapoint
add_datapoint.description: Declare an extra datapoint of the OZW672 menutree. Leave enum_options empty for numeric datapoints, otherwise use a '1=Label, 2=Label' list.

abort.no_custom_datapoints: No custom datapoint has been declared yet.

write_datapoint.name: Write datapoint
write_datapoint.description: Write a value to an arbitrary datapoint of a Siemens OZW672 device.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Target OZW672 config entry. Optional when only one is configured.

datapoint_id.name: Datapoint id
datapoint_id.description: Numeric identifier of the datapoint in the OZW672 menutree.

value_type.name: Value type
value_type.description: OZW672 datapoint type. Use Enumeration for switch-like datapoints.
